question: A company has an organization in AWS Organizations. The company wants to use AWS CloudFormation StackSets in the organization to deploy various AWS design patterns into environments. options.A: Configure GuardDuty to send the event to an Amazon Kinesis data stream. Process the event with an Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics for Apache Flink application that sends a notification to the company through Amazon Simple Notification Service Amazon SNS .Add rules to the network ACL to block traffic to and from the suspicious instance.
options.B: Configure GuardDuty to send the event to Amazon EventBridge. Deploy an AWS WAF web ACL. explanations.A: 、 Security Hub 等） 。 ⽹ 络安全控制（ AWS Network Firewall 、 Security Group 、 ACL 等） 。 选项分析 A. 配置 GuardDuty 将事件发送到 Amazon Kinesis 数据流，并使 ⽤ Kinesis Data Analytics 处理事 件。 错误原因： 虽然可以通过 Kinesis 数据流处理事件，但使 ⽤ ⽹ 络 ACL 来阻 ⽌ 流量并不适合动态阻 ⽌ 特定实例的通 信 ，因为 ⽹ 络 ACL 是针对整个 ⼦ ⽹ 的规则， ⽆ 法针对单个实例进 ⾏ 精确控制。 此 ⽅ 案复杂且不符合题 ⽬ 要求的最佳实践。

question: A company has an AWS account that hosts a production application. The company receives an email notification that Amazon GuardDuty has detected an Impact:IAMUser/AnomalousBehavior finding in the account. options.A: Log in to the AWS account by using read-only credentials. Review the GuardDuty finding for details about the IAM credentials that were used. Use the IAM console to add a DenyAl policy to the IAM principal.
options.B: Log in to the AWS account by using read-only credentials. Review the GuardDuty finding to determine which API cals initiated the finding. Use Amazon Detective to review the API cals in context.
options.C: Log in to the AWS account by using administrator credentials. Review the GuardDuty finding for details about the IAM credentials that were used. Use the IAM console to add a DenyAl policy to the IAM principal.
options.D: Log in to the AWS account by using read-only credentials. Review the GuardDuty finding to determine which API cals initiated the finding. Use AWS CloudTrail Insights and AWS CloudTrail Lake to review the API cals in context.

explanations.A: Log in to the AWS account by using read-only credentials. Review the GuardDuty finding for details about the IAM credentials that were used. explanations.B: Log in to the AWS account by using read-only credentials. Review the GuardDuty finding to determine which API calls initiated the finding. Use Amazon Detective to review the API calls in context. 正确：使 ⽤ 只读凭证可以避免对 ⽣ 产环境的影响。 Amazon Detective 是专 ⻔ 设计 ⽤ 于分析安全事件的 ⼯ 具， 可以提供 API 调 ⽤ 的上下 ⽂ 信息，帮助快速 调查事件。 这是最符合题 ⽬ 要求的解决 ⽅ 案。
explanations.C: Log in to the AWS account by using administrator credentials. Review the GuardDuty finding for details about the IAM credentials that were use
explanations.D: Log in to the AWS account by using read-only credentials. Review the GuardDuty finding to determine which API calls initiated the finding. Use AWS CloudTrail Insights and AWS CloudTrail Lake to review the API calls in context. 错误：虽然 CloudTrail Insights 和 CloudTrail Lake 可以提供 API 调 ⽤ 的上下 ⽂ 信息，但 它们的功能不 如 Amazon Detective 专注于安全事件调查。 Amazon Detective 是专 ⻔ 设计 ⽤ 于分析安全事件的 ⼯ 具，使 ⽤ 它可以更快速地满 ⾜ 题 ⽬ 要求。

question: Company A has an AWS account that is named Account A. Company A recently acquired Company B, which has an AWS account that is named Account B. Company B stores its files in an Amazon S3 bucket. The administrators need to give a user from Account A ful access to the S3 bucket in Account B. After the administrators adjust the IAM permissions for the user in Account A to access the S3 bucket in Account B, the user sti l cannot access any files in the S3 bucket. Which solution wi l resolve this issue?

options.A: In Account B, create a bucket ACL to alow the user from Account A to access the S3 bucket in Account
options.B: B In Account B, create an object ACL to alow the user from Account A to access al the objects in the S3 bucket in Account B. C.In Account B, create a bucket policy to alow the user from Account A to access the S3 bucket in Account B. D.In Account B, create a user policy to alow the user from Account A to access the S3 bucket in Account B.

explanations.B: 中，创建 ⼀ 个 bucket ACL ，以允许账户 A 的 ⽤ 户访问账户 B 中的 S3 bucket 。 Bucket ACL 主要 ⽤ 于授予基本的读写权限，但它的功能有限， ⽆ 法提供细粒度的权限控制。 ACL 不 ⽀ 持跨账户的复杂权限管理，尤其是 ⽆ 法直接授予账户 A 的 ⽤ 户对整个 bucket 的访问权限。 因此此选项错误。 B. 在账户 B 中，创建 ⼀ 个 object ACL ，以允许账户 A 的 ⽤ 户访问账户 B 中 S3 bucket 中的所有对 象。 Object ACL 仅适 ⽤ 于单个对象的权限管理， ⽆ 法批量管理整个 bucket 的权限。 如果 bucket 中有 ⼤ 量对象，逐个设置 ACL 是不可 ⾏ 的，且不符合最佳实践。 因此此选项错误。 C. 在账户 B 中，创建 ⼀ 个 bucket policy ，以允许账户 A 的 ⽤ 户访问账户 B 中的 S3 bucket 。 Bucket Policy 是管理 S3 bucket 访问权限的推荐 ⽅ 式， ⽀ 持跨账户访问。 通过 bucket policy ，可以明确指定账户 A 的 ⽤ 户对 bucket 的访问权限。 此选项正确。 D. 在账户 B 中，创建 ⼀ 个 user policy ，以允许账户 A 的 ⽤ 户访问账户 B 中的 S3 bucket 。 User Policy 是针对账户 B 内部 ⽤ 户的权限管理， ⽆ 法直接授予账户 A 的 ⽤ 户权限。 跨账户访问需要使 ⽤ bucket policy ， ⽽ 不是 user policy 。 因此此选项错误。

question: A company wants to receive an email notification about critical findings in AWS Security Hub. The company does not have an existing architecture that supports this functionality. Which solution wi l meet the requirement?

explanations.A: 创建 ⼀ 个 AWS Lambda 函数来识别关键的 Security Hu
explanations.B: 创建 ⼀ 个 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 交付流。将交付流与 Amazon EventBridge 集成。创 建 ⼀ 个具有过滤器以 检测关键 Security Hub 发现的 EventBridge 规则。配置交付流将发现发送到电 ⼦ 邮件地址。 错误： Kinesis Data Firehose 主要 ⽤ 于数据流的持久化和分析，不适合直接发送电 ⼦ 邮件通知。此选 项复杂且不符合需 求。
explanations.C: 创建 ⼀ 个 Amazon EventBridge 规则以检测关键 Security Hub 发现。创建 ⼀ 个 Amazon SNS 主 题作为 EventBridge 规则的 ⽬ 标。将电 ⼦ 邮件端点订阅到 SNS 主题以接收发布的消息。 正确： EventBridge 可以直接检测 Security Hub 的关键发现，并将事件发送到 SNS 。 SNS ⽀ 持电 ⼦ 邮 件订阅，能够满 ⾜ 通知 需求。

question: An international company has established a new business entity in South Korea. The company also has established a new AWS account to contain the workload for the South Korean region. The solution also must keep the logs for only the required period of 7 years. Which combination of steps should the security engineer take to meet these requirements? Choose three.)

options.A: Ensure that the Amazon CloudWatch agent is instaled on al the EC2 instances that the Auto Scaling groups launch. Generate a CloudWatch agent configuration file to forward the required logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs.
options.B: Set the log retention for desired log groups to 7 years.

options.E: Ensure that a log forwarding application is insta led on a l the EC2 instances that the Auto Scaling groups launch. Configure the log forwarding application to periodically bundle the logs and forward the logs to Amazon S3.
options.F: Configure an Amazon S3 Lifecycle policy on the target S3 bucket to expire objects after 7 years.

explanations.A: 正确：安装 CloudWatch agent 并配置 ⽇ 志转发是确保 ⽇ 志数据不会丢失的关键步骤。 CloudWatch Logs 可以可靠地存储 ⽇ 志数据。

explanations.D: 错误： 题 ⽬ 要求使 ⽤ CloudWatch Logs 作为 ⽇ 志存储， ⽽ 不是 Amazon S3 。
explanations.E: 错误：题 ⽬ 没有提到使 ⽤ ⽇ 志转发应 ⽤ 程序，也没有要求将 ⽇ 志转发到 Amazon S3 。
explanations.F: 错误： 题 ⽬ 要求使 ⽤ CloudWatch Logs 存储 ⽇ 志， ⽽ 不是 Amazon S3 ，因此 S3 ⽣ 命周期策略不适 ⽤ 。

question: A security engineer is designing an IAM policy to protect AWS API operations. The policy must enforce multi-factor authentication MFA) for IAM users to access certain services in the AWS production account. Each session must remain valid for only 2 hours. The current version of the IAM policy is as folows: Which combination of conditions must the security engineer add to the IAM policy to meet these requirements? Choose two.)

options.A: "Bool": {"aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent": "true"}
options.B: "Bool": {"aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent": "false"}
options.C: "NumericLessThan": {"aws:MultiFactorAuthAge": "7200"}
options.D: "NumericGreaterThan": {"aws:MultiFactorAuthAge": "7200"}
options.E: "NumericLessThan": {"MaxSessionDuration": "7200"}

explanations.A: ）相关条件。 如何限制会话的有效时间。 安全性最佳实践：强制 MFA 和限制会话时 ⻓ 。 选项分析 A. "Bool": {"aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent": "true"} 此选项正确。此条件 ⽤ 于检查 ⽤ 户是否启 ⽤ 了 MFA 。如果 MFA 未启 ⽤ ，则 ⽤ 户 ⽆ 法执 ⾏ 指定的操作。 符合题 ⽬ 要求。
explanations.B: "Bool": {"aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent": "false"} 此选项错误。此条件表 ⽰ ⽤ 户未启 ⽤ MFA 时允许操作，与题 ⽬ 要求强制 MFA 相违背。
explanations.C: "NumericLessThan": {"aws:MultiFactorAuthAge": "7200"} 此选项正确。此条件 ⽤ 于限制 MFA 会话的有效时间为 2 ⼩ 时（ 7200 秒） 。符合题 ⽬ 要求。
explanations.D: "NumericGreaterThan": {"aws:MultiFactorAuthAge": "7200"} 此选项错误。此条件表 ⽰ MFA 会话超过 2 ⼩ 时后允许操作，与题 ⽬ 要求限制会话时 ⻓ 相违背。
explanations.E: "NumericLessThan": {"MaxSessionDuration": "7200"} 此选项错误。 MaxSessionDuration 是 ⽤ 于 ⾓ ⾊ 的会话时 ⻓ 设置， ⽽ 不是 MFA 相关条件，与题 ⽬ 要求 不符。

question: A company uses AWS Organizations and has production workloads across multiple AWS accounts. A security engineer needs to design a solution that wi l proactively monitor for suspicious behavior across a l the accounts that contain production workloads. The solution must automate remediation of incidents across the production accounts. In addition, the solution must send al security incident logs to a dedicated account. Which solution wi l meet these requirements?

options.A: Activate Amazon GuardDuty in each production account. In a dedicated logging account, aggregate al GuardDuty logs from each production account. Remediate incidents by configuring GuardDuty to directly invoke an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to also publish notifications to the SNS topic.
options.B: Activate AWS Security Hub in each production account. In a dedicated logging account, aggregate al Security Hub findings from each production account. Remediate incidents by using AWS Config and AWS Systems Manager. Configure Systems Manager to also publish notifications to the SNS topic.
options.C: Activate Amazon GuardDuty in each production account. In a dedicated logging account, aggregate al GuardDuty logs from each production account. Remediate incidents by using Amazon EventBridge to invoke a custom AWS Lambda function from the GuardDuty findings. Configure the Lambda function to also publish notifications to the SNS topic.
options.D: Activate AWS Security Hub in each production account. In a dedicated logging account, aggregate al Security Hub findings from each production account. Remediate incidents by using Amazon EventBridge to invoke a custom AWS Lambda function from the Security Hub findings. Configure the Lambda function to also publish notifications to the SNS topic.

explanations.A: 函数进 ⾏ ⾃ 动化响应。 Amazon SNS ⽤ 于通知机制。 选项分析 A 正确性：激活 Amazon GuardDuty 是正确的，因为它是专 ⻔ ⽤ 于检测和响应安全威胁的服务。 错误点： GuardDuty ⽆ 法直接调 ⽤ AWS Lambda 函数进 ⾏ ⾃ 动化响应，必须通过 Amazon EventBridge 来实现事件驱动的 ⾃ 动化处理。
explanations.B: 正确性：激活 AWS Security Hub 可以汇总安全发现，但它主要 ⽤ 于集中管理和合规性检查， ⽽ 不是 实时检测和响应。 错误点： AWS Config 和 AWS Systems Manager 虽然可以 ⽤ 于合规性和 ⾃ 动化管理，但它们不是最 佳选择来处理实时安全 事件。
explanations.C: 正确性：激活 Amazon GuardDuty 是正确的，因为它可以检测安全威胁。 正确性：使 ⽤ Amazon EventBridge 从 GuardDuty 发现中触发 AWS Lambda 函数是正确的，因为 EventBridge 可以实现事件驱动的 ⾃ 动化响应。 正确性：配置 Lambda 函数发布通知到 SNS 主题是正确的，因为 SNS 可以 ⽤ 于通知机制。
explanations.D: 正确性：激活 AWS Security Hub 是正确的，但它主要 ⽤ 于合规性检查和集中管理， ⽽ 不是实时检测 和响应。 错误点：虽然可以使 ⽤ Amazon EventBridge 触发 Lambda 函数，但 Security Hub 不是最佳选择来处 理实时安全事件。

question: A company is designing a multi-account structure for its development teams. The company is using AWS Organizations and AWS IAM Identity Center AWS Single Sign-On). options.A: Use IAM Identity Center to set up service-linked roles with IAM policy statements that include the Condition, Resource, and NotAction elements to alow access to only the Regions and services that are needed.
options.B: Deactivate AWS Security Token Service AWS STS) in Regions that the developers are not alowed to use.
options.C: Create SCPs that include the Condition, Resource, and NotAction elements to alow access to only the Regions and services that are needed.
options.D: For each AWS account, create tailored identity-based policies for IAM Identity Center. Use statements that include the Condition, Resource, and NotAction elements to alow access to only the Regions and services that are needed.

explanations.A: 使 ⽤ IAM Identity Center 设置带有 IAM 策略语句的服务关联 ⾓ ⾊ ： 错误： IAM Identity Center 主要 ⽤ 于 ⽤ 户 ⾝ 份管理和单点登录， ⽽ 不是直接限制账户对区域和服务的 访问。 IAM 策略 ⽆ 法 跨账户统 ⼀ 管理，且操作开销较 ⾼ 。

question: While securing the connection between a company ʼ s VPC and its on-premises data center, a security engineer sent a ping command from an on-premises host IP address 203.0.113.12) to an Amazon EC2 instance IP address 172.31.16.139 . The ping command did not return a response. The flow log in the VPC showed the following: What action should be performed to allow the ping to work?

options.A: In the security group of the EC2 instance, allow inbound ICMP traffic.
options.B: In the security group of the EC2 instance, allow outbound ICMP traffic.
options.C: In the VPC ʼ s NACL, allow inbound ICMP traffic.
options.D: In the VPC ʼ s NACL, allow outbound ICMP traffic.

explanations.A: 在 EC2 实例的安全组中，允许 ⼊ 站 ICMP 流量。 错误。安全组是状态性的，允许 ⼊ 站流量后会 ⾃ 动允许相关的出站流量。根据流 ⽇ 志， ⼊ 站流量已经 被接受 （ ACCEPT ） ，问题出在出站流量被拒绝（ REJECT ） 。因此修改安全组的 ⼊ 站规则 ⽆ 法解决问题。
explanations.B: 在 EC2 实例的安全组中，允许出站 ICMP 流量。 错误。虽然安全组控制出站流量，但流 ⽇ 志显 ⽰ 出站流量被 NACL 拒绝（ REJECT ） 。安全组的出站规 则已经不是问题 所在。
explanations.C: ⽹ 络访问控制列表（ NACL ）和安全组的配置， 以及如何排查 ⽹ 络 连接问题。 具体涉及 ICMP 协议的流量控制和如何正确配置 NACL 以允许双向通信。 选项分析 A. 在 EC2 实例的安全组中，允许 ⼊ 站 ICMP 流量。 错误。安全组是状态性的，允许 ⼊ 站流量后会 ⾃ 动允许相关的出站流量。根据流 ⽇ 志， ⼊ 站流量已经 被接受 （ ACCEPT ） ，问题出在出站流量被拒绝（ REJECT ） 。因此修改安全组的 ⼊ 站规则 ⽆ 法解决问题。 B. 在 EC2 实例的安全组中，允许出站 ICMP 流量。 错误。虽然安全组控制出站流量，但流 ⽇ 志显 ⽰ 出站流量被 NACL 拒绝（ REJECT ） 。安全组的出站规 则已经不是问题 所在。 C. 在 VPC 的 NACL 中，允许 ⼊ 站 ICMP 流量。 错误。流 ⽇ 志显 ⽰ ⼊ 站流量已经被接受（ ACCEPT ） ，问题出在出站流量被拒绝（ REJECT ） 。修改 NACL 的 ⼊ 站规则 ⽆ 法解决问题。
explanations.D: 在 VPC 的 NACL 中，允许出站 ICMP 流量。 正确。流 ⽇ 志显 ⽰ 出站流量被 NACL 拒绝（ REJECT ） 。 NACL 是 ⽆ 状态的，需要显式允许出站 ICMP 流 量才能解决问题。

question: A company developed an application by using AWS Lambda, Amazon S3, Amazon Simple Notification Service Amazon SNS , and Amazon DynamoDB. An external application puts objects into the company's S3 bucket and tags the objects with date and time. A Lambda function periodically pulls data from the company's S3 bucket based on date and time tags and inserts specific values into a DynamoDB table for further processing. The data includes personally identifiable information PII . The company must remove data that is older than 30 days from the S3 bucket and the DynamoDB table. Which solution will meet this requirement with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: Update the Lambda function to add a TTL S3 flag to S3 objects. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to expire objects that are older than 30 days by using the TTL S3 flag.
options.B: Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to expire objects that are older than 30 days. Update the Lambda function to add the TTL attribute in the DynamoDB table. Enable TTL on the DynamoDB table to expire entries that are older than 30 days based on the TTL attribute.
options.C: Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to expire objects that are older than 30 days and to add all prefixes to the S3 bucket. Update the Lambda function to delete entries that are older than 30 days.
options.D: Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to expire objects that are older than 30 days by using object tags. Update the Lambda function to delete entries that are older than 30 days.

explanations.A: 更新 Lambda 函数以向 S3 对象添加 TTL S3 标志。创建 ⼀ 个 S3 ⽣ 命周期策略，通过使 ⽤ TTL S3 标志来过期超过 30 天的对象。 错误原因： S3 对象的 ⽣ 命周期策略不需要依赖 ⾃ 定义的 TTL 标志。 S3 Lifecycle 可以直接基于对象的创建 ⽇ 期来 过期对象。
explanations.B: Time-to-Live TTL 功能的使 ⽤ 。 如何设计 ⾼ 效的 ⽆ 服务器架构以满 ⾜ 数据 ⽣ 命周期管理需求。 数据隐私和合规性要求（如处理 PII 数据） 。 选项分析 A. 更新 Lambda 函数以向 S3 对象添加 TTL S3 标志。创建 ⼀ 个 S3 ⽣ 命周期策略，通过使 ⽤ TTL S3 标志来过期超过 30 天的对象。 错误原因： S3 对象的 ⽣ 命周期策略不需要依赖 ⾃ 定义的 TTL 标志。 S3 Lifecycle 可以直接基于对象的创建 ⽇ 期来 过期对象。 B. 创建 ⼀ 个 S3 ⽣ 命周期策略以过期超过 30 天的对象。更新 Lambda 函数以在 DynamoDB 表中添 加 TTL 属性。启 ⽤ DynamoDB 表上的 TTL ，以基于 TTL 属性过期超过 30 天的条 ⽬ 。 正确原因： S3 Lifecycle 策略可以直接管理 S3 对象的过期， ⽆ 需额外的标志或复杂逻辑。 DynamoDB 的 TTL 功能是专 ⻔ 设计 ⽤ 于 ⾃ 动删除过期数据的，使 ⽤ TTL 属性可以 ⾼ 效地管理数据 ⽣ 命 周期。 此选项提供了最少的操作复杂性，同时满 ⾜ 了删除过期数据的需求。
explanations.C: 创建 ⼀ 个 S3 ⽣ 命周期策略以过期超过 30 天的对象，并向 S3 bucket 添加所有前缀。更新 Lambda 函数以删除 超过 30 天的条 ⽬ 。 错误原因： 添加所有前缀并不必要，因为 S3 Lifecycle 策略可以直接基于对象的创建 ⽇ 期进 ⾏ 管理。 依赖 Lambda 函数来删除 DynamoDB 中的过期数据增加了操作复杂性， ⽽ DynamoDB TTL 功能可以 ⾃ 动处理过期数据。
explanations.D: 创建 ⼀ 个 S3 ⽣ 命周期策略以通过使 ⽤ 对象标签过期超过 30 天的对象。更新 Lambda 函数以删除 超过 30 天的 条 ⽬ 。 错误原因： 虽然可以使 ⽤ 对象标签来管理 S3 ⽣ 命周期，但这增加了额外的复杂性，因为需要确保所有对象都正确 地被标记。 依赖 Lambda 函数来删除 DynamoDB 中的过期数据增加了操作复杂性， ⽽ DynamoDB TTL 功能可以 ⾃ 动处理过期数据。

question: A company is expanding its group of stores. On the day that each new store opens, the company wants to launch a customized web application for that store. question:
A company uses identity federation to authenticate users in an identity account (987654321987), where users assume an IAM role named IdentityRole. Users then assume an IAM role named JobFunctionRole in a target AWS account (123456789123) to perform their job functions.

Users are unable to assume the IAM role in the target account. The policy attached to the role in the identity account is:

{ "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [ { "Action": [ "sts:AssumeRole" ], "Resource": [ "arn:aws:iam::*:role/JobFunctionRole" ], "Effect": "Allow" } ] }

What should be done to enable users to assume the appropriate role in the target account?

options.A: Update the IAM policy attached to the role in the identity account to be: { "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [ { "Action": [ "sts:AssumeRole" ], "Resource": [ "arn:aws:iam::123456789123:role/JobFunctionRole" ], "Effect": "Allow" } ] }
options.B: Update the trust policy on the role in the target account to be: { "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [ { "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::987654321987:role/IdentityRole" }, "Action": "sts:AssumeRole" } ] }
options.C: Update the trust policy on the role in the identity account to be: { "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [ { "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::987654321987:root" }, "Action": "sts:AssumeRole" } ] }
options.D: Update the IAM policy attached to the role in the target account to be: { "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [ { "Sid": "Stmt1502946463000", "Effect": "Allow", "Action": "sts:AssumeRole", "Resource": "arn:aws:iam::123456789123:role/JobFunctionRole" } ] }

explanations.A: Incorrect. The IAM policy in the identity account already allows users to call sts:AssumeRole with the resource specified as arn:aws:iam::*:role/JobFunctionRole, which is already correctly configured. Changing the wildcard * to a specific account ID would not solve the problem, as the issue is not with the identity account's IAM policy but with the target account's trust policy.
explanations.B: Correct. The JobFunctionRole in the target account needs to trust the IdentityRole in the identity account to allow users from the identity account to access resources in the target account via sts:AssumeRole. Setting the Principal to arn:aws:iam::987654321987:role/IdentityRole in the trust policy ensures only users who have assumed the IdentityRole can cross-account assume the JobFunctionRole.
explanations.C: Incorrect. The trust policy of the IdentityRole in the identity account is unrelated to the problem, as the issue is with the trust policy configuration on the target account's role. Modifying the identity account role's trust policy cannot resolve the cross-account access issue.
explanations.D: Incorrect. The IAM policy in the target account controls the role's permissions (what actions the role can perform), not the trust relationship (who can assume the role). The core issue is the trust policy, not the IAM permissions policy.

question: A company is using AWS Organizations to manage multiple AWS accounts for its human resources, finance, software development, and production departments. All the company's developers are part of the software development AWS account. The company discovers that developers have launched Amazon EC2 instances that were preconfigured with software that the company has not approved for use. The company wants to implement a solution to ensure that developers can launch EC2 instances with only approved software applications and only in the software development AWS account. Which solution will meet these requirements?

Include the AMI IDs in the condition section of an AWS CloudFormation template to launch the appropriate AMI based on the AWS Region. Configure Run Command to run a script that wil instal al approved software onto the instances that the developers launch.
options.C: Use an AWS Service Catalog portfolio that contains EC2 products with appropriate AMIs that include only approved software. Grant the developers permission to access only the Service Catalog portfolio to launch a product in the software development account.
options.D: In the management account, create AMIs of preconfigured instances that include only approved software. Use AWS CloudFormation StackSets to launch the AMIs across any AWS account in the organization. Grant the developers permission to launch the stack sets within the management account.

explanations.A: 在软件开发账户中，创建仅包含批准软件的预配置实例的 AMIs ，并使 ⽤ CloudFormation 模板： 此选项提供了 ⼀ 种 ⽅ 法来限制开发 ⼈ 员使 ⽤ 特定的 AMI ，但它依赖开发 ⼈ 员正确使 ⽤ CloudFormation 模板。开发 ⼈ 员仍 然可以绕过模板直接启动未经批准的 AMI ，因此 ⽆ 法完全满 ⾜ 要求。 错误原因： ⽆ 法强制开发 ⼈ 员仅使 ⽤ 指定的 AMI 。
explanations.B: 使 ⽤ Amazon EventBridge 规则和 AWS Systems Manager Run Command ： 此选项试图通过事件触发脚本来安装批准的软件，但它 ⽆ 法阻 ⽌ 开发 ⼈ 员启动未经批准的 AMI 。此 ⽅ 法是事后补救， ⽽ 不是预防措施。 错误原因： ⽆ 法确保开发 ⼈ 员仅启动包含批准软件的实例。
explanations.C: 使 ⽤ AWS Service Catalog 组合： 此选项通过 Service Catalog 提供了 ⼀ 个集中管理的解决 ⽅ 案，开发 ⼈ 员只能访问包含批准软件的 EC2 产品。 ServiceCatalog 可以强制开发 ⼈ 员仅使 ⽤ 预配置的资源。 正确原因：完全满 ⾜ 要求，确保开发 ⼈ 员只能启动包含批准软件的实例。

question: A company has enabled Amazon GuardDuty in al AWS Regions as part of its security monitoring strategy. In one of its VPCs, the company hosts an Amazon EC2 instance that works as an FTP server. A high number of clients from multiple locations contact the FTP server. GuardDuty identifies this activity as a brute force attack because of the high number of connections that happen every hour. The company has flagged the finding as a false positive, but GuardDuty continues to raise the issue. A security engineer must improve the signal-to-noise ratio without compromising the company's visibility of potential anomalous behavior. Which solution wi l meet these requirements?

options.A: Disable the FTP rule in GuardDuty in the Region where the FTP server is deployed.
options.B: Add the FTP server to a trusted IP list. Deploy the list to GuardDuty to stop receiving the notifications.
options.C: Create a suppression rule in GuardDuty to filter findings by automaticaly archiving new findings that match the specified criteria.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda function that has the appropriate permissions to delete the finding whenever a new occurrence is reported.

explanations.A: 禁 ⽤ GuardDuty 中的 FTP 规则： 错误。禁 ⽤ FTP 规则会完全关闭对 FTP 相关活动的监控，这可能导致真正的异常 ⾏ 为 ⽆ 法被检测到， 从 ⽽ 降低安全性。 这种 ⽅ 法不符合题 ⽬ 要求的 “ 改善信号与噪声 ⽐ ，同时保持对潜在异常 ⾏ 为的可 ⻅ 性 ” 。

question: A company's security engineer has been tasked with restricting a contractor's IAM account access to the company ʼ s Amazon EC2 console without providing access to any other AWS services. question: A company manages multiple AWS accounts using AWS Organizations. explanations.B: Deploy an AWS Lambda function in every account to check if there is an existing trail and create a new trail, if needed. 正确性分析：使 ⽤ Lambda 函数可以检查和创建 trail ，但需要在每个账户中部署 Lambda ，管理复杂性 ⾼ 。 错误原因：这种 ⽅ 法 ⽆ 法 ⾃ 动覆盖未来创建的账户，且需要额外的运维 ⼯ 作。

question: A company's AWS CloudTrail logs are all centrally stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. The security team controls the company's AWS accounts. The security team must prevent unauthorized access and tampering of the CloudTrail logs. Which combination of steps should the security team take? (Choose three.)

options.D: Implement least privilege access to the S3 bucket by configuring a bucket policy.
options.E: Configure CloudTrail log file integrity validation.

explanations.A: Correct. Using SSE-KMS ensures that log files are encrypted at rest, preventing unauthorized access. This is an important measure for protecting data at rest.
explanations.B: Incorrect. While compressing log files can save storage space, it is unrelated to preventing unauthorized access and tampering, and is not a core requirement for CloudTrail log security.
explanations.C: Incorrect. While notification mechanisms can help monitor log file modifications, they cannot directly prevent unauthorized access or tampering. This option is not part of best practices for this scenario.
explanations.D: Correct. By configuring a bucket policy and implementing the principle of least privilege, access to log files can be restricted, preventing unauthorized access.
explanations.E: Correct. CloudTrail log file integrity validation can detect whether log files have been tampered with, and is an important step in ensuring log file security.
explanations.F: Incorrect. Access Analyzer for S3 is primarily used to analyze bucket access permissions, but it cannot directly prevent log file tampering or unauthorized access.

The company's compliance team asks a security officer to develop a strategy that wi l prevent anyone from changing or deleting the data. Which solution wi l meet this requirement MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure the bucket to use S3 Object Lock in compliance mode. Upload the data to the bucket. Create a resource-based bucket policy that meets al the regulatory requirements.
options.B: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure the bucket to use S3 Object Lock in governance mode. Upload the data to the bucket. Create a user-based IAM policy that meets al the regulatory requirements.
options.C: Create a vault in Amazon S3 Glacier. Create a Vault Lock policy in S3 Glacier that meets al the regulatory requirements. Upload the data to the vault.
options.D: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Upload the data to the bucket. Use a lifecycle rule to transition the data to a vault in S3 Glacier. Create a Vault Lock policy that meets al the regulatory requirements.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure the bucket to use S3 Object Lock in compliance mode. Upload the data to the bucket. Create a resource-based bucket policy that meets all the regulatory requirements. 正确性分析：使 ⽤ S3 Object Lock 的合规模式可以防 ⽌ 数据被修改或删除，符合监管要求。但 S3 存储 成本较 ⾼ ，尤其是 对于需要 ⻓ 期保存的数据（ 7 年） 。 成本效益分析：相 ⽐ S3 Glacier ， S3 的存储成本更 ⾼ ，因此不是最具成本效益的解决 ⽅ 案。 结论：虽然技术上可 ⾏ ，但不是最具成本效益的选项。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure the bucket to use S3 Object Lock in governance mode. Upload the data to the bucket. Create a user-based IAM policy that meets all the regulatory requirements. 正确性分析：治理模式允许特定 ⽤ 户通过权限解除锁定，这可能导致数据被修改或删除，不完全符合 监管要求。 成本效益分析：与选项 A 类似， S3 存储成本较 ⾼ ，且治理模式不适合严格的合规需求。 结论：不符合监管要求，且成本较 ⾼ 。
explanations.C: Create a vault in Amazon S3 Glacier. Create a Vault Lock policy in S3 Glacier that meets all the regulatory requirements. Upload the data to the vault. 正确性分析： Amazon S3 Glacier Vault Lock 允许创建不可更改的策略，确保数据 ⽆ 法被修改或删 除，完全符合监管要 求。 成本效益分析： S3 Glacier 是专为 ⻓ 期数据存储设计的，成本远低于 S3 ，适合存储 ⼤ 规模数据（如 ⼏ PB ）并满 ⾜ 7 年的 保留要求。 结论：技术上可 ⾏ 且成本效益最 ⾼ ，是最佳选项。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Upload the data to the bucket. Use a lifecycle rule to transition the data to a vault in S3 Glacier. Create a Vault Lock policy that meets all the regulatory requirements. 正确性分析：虽然可以通过 ⽣ 命周期规则将数据转移到 S3 Glacier ，但初始存储在 S3 中会增加不必要 的成本。最终仍需 在 S3 Glacier 中创建 Vault Lock 策略。 成本效益分析：相 ⽐ 直接使 ⽤ S3 Glacier （选项 C ） ，此选项增加了额外的 S3 存储成本，且流程更复 杂。 结论：技术上可 ⾏ ，但成本效益较低，不是最佳选项。

question: A-company uses a third-party identity provider and SAML-based SSO for its AWS accounts. After the third-party identity provider renewed an expired signing certificate, users saw the folowing message when trying to log in: Error: Response Signature Invalid Service: AWSSecurityTokenService; Status Code: 400; Error Code: InvalidIdentityToken) A security engineer needs to provide a solution that corrects the error and minimizes operational overhead. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Upload the third-party signing certificate ʼ s new private key to the AWS identity provider entity defined in AWS Identity and Access Management IAM) by using the AWS Management Console.
options.B: Sign the identity provider's metadata file with the new public key. Upload the signature to the AWS identity provider entity defined in AWS Identity and Access Management IAM) by using the AWS CLI.
options.C: Download the updated SAML metadata file from the identity service provider. Update the file in the AWS identity provider entity defined in AWS Identity and Access Management IAM) by using the AWS CLI.
options.D: Configure the AWS identity provider entity defined in AWS Identity and Access Management IAM) to synchronously fetch the new public key by using the AWS Management Console.

explanations.A: 错误原因：私钥是敏感信息，不能上传到 AWS 。 AWS 只需要验证签名的公钥， ⽽ 不是私钥。
explanations.B: 错误原因：公钥不能 ⽤ 于签名操作。签名是由私钥完成的，公钥 ⽤ 于验证签名。此选项的描述不符合 实际操作流程。
explanations.C: 正确原因：当第三 ⽅ ⾝ 份提供商更新了签名证书后， SAML 元数据 ⽂ 件会包含新的证书信息。下载更 新后的元数据 ⽂ 件并上传到 AWS IAM 中的 ⾝ 份提供商实体是解决问题的正确 ⽅ 法。

question: A company runs multiple workloads on AWS. Employees need to authenticate using on-premises ADFS and SSO to access the AWS Management Console. Developers have migrated an existing legacy web application to Amazon EC2 instances. Employees need to access this application from anywhere on the internet, but the application does not currently have a built-in authentication system. How should the security engineer implement employee-only access to this system without changing the application?

options.A: Place the application behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Use Amazon Cognito as the authentication for the ALB. Define a SAML-based Amazon Cognito user pool and connect it to ADFS.
options.B: Implement AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) in the management account and connect it to ADFS as an identity provider. Define the EC2 instance as a managed resource and apply IAM policies to the resource.
options.C: Define an Amazon Cognito identity pool and install a connector on the Active Directory server. Use the Amazon Cognito SDK on the application instance to authenticate employees with Active Directory usernames and passwords.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda custom authorizer as the authenticator for a reverse proxy on Amazon EC2. Ensure that the security group on Amazon EC2 only allows access from the Lambda function.

explanations.A: Correct. ALB supports authentication features and can integrate SAML identity providers (such as ADFS) through Amazon Cognito. This approach requires no modification to the application code — only ALB and Cognito configuration is needed to implement employee authentication. Employees can authenticate through ADFS and access the application via the ALB.
explanations.B: Incorrect. AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS SSO) is primarily used for managing access to AWS accounts and services, not for directly protecting applications on EC2 instances. IAM policies cannot directly control application-level access on EC2 instances.
explanations.C: Incorrect. This option requires modifying the application code to integrate the Amazon Cognito SDK, which contradicts the requirement of not changing the application. Additionally, the question does not call for an Amazon Cognito identity pool — a user pool with SAML integration would be more appropriate.
explanations.D: Incorrect. This option requires developing a custom Lambda function and reverse proxy, adding complexity and requiring changes to the application's access architecture. The question calls for a simple solution, not a complex custom implementation.

question: A company is using AWS to run a long-running analysis process on data that is stored in Amazon S3 buckets. The process runs on a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances that are in an Auto Scaling group. The EC2 instances are deployed in a private subnet of a VPC that does not have internet access. The EC2 instances and the S3 buckets are in the same AWS account. The EC2 instances access the S3 buckets through an S3 gateway endpoint that has the default access policy. Each EC2 instance is associated with an instance profile role that has a policy that explicitly allows the s3 GetObject action and the s3 PutObject action for only the required S3 buckets. A security engineer must implement a solution to stop this exfiltration of data and to keep the EC2 processing job functional. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Update the policy on the S3 gateway endpoint to allow the S3 actions only if the values of the aws:ResourceOrgID and aws:PrincipalOrgID condition keys match the company's values.
options.B: Update the policy on the instance profile role to allow the S3 actions only if the value of the aws:ResourceOrgID condition key matches the company's value.
options.C: Add a network ACL rule to the subnet of the EC2 instances to block outgoing connections on port 443.
options.D: Apply an SCP on the AWS account to allow the S3 actions only if the values of the aws:ResourceOrgID and aws:PrincipalOrgID condition keys match the company's values.

explanations.A: 分析：此选项正确。通过更新 S3 ⽹ 关端点的策略，可以限制只有属于公司组织的资源和主体才能访问 S3 。这种 ⽅ 法直接在 ⽹ 关端点层 ⾯ 控制访问，确保数据不会被泄露到外部组织的 S3 存储桶，同时保持 EC2 实例的正常功能。
explanations.B: 分析：此选项错误。虽然可以通过实例配置 ⽂ 件 ⾓ ⾊ 限制访问，但这 ⽆ 法阻 ⽌ 被攻击的实例直接通过 ⽹ 关端点访问外部 S3 存储桶。实例 ⾓ ⾊ 的策略仅适 ⽤ 于实例本 ⾝ 的权限， ⽽ ⽹ 关端点的默认策略仍然 允许访问。
explanations.C: 分析：此选项错误。阻 ⽌ 端 ⼝ 443 上的出站连接会影响 EC2 实例的正常功能，因为 S3 使 ⽤ HTTPS （端 ⼝ 443 ）进 ⾏ 通信。这种 ⽅ 法会导致分析任务 ⽆ 法正常运 ⾏ 。
explanations.D: 分析：此选项错误。 SCP （服务控制策略）适 ⽤ 于整个账户的权限管理，但它 ⽆ 法直接控制 ⽹ 关端点 的 ⾏ 为。此外， SCP 的应 ⽤ 可能会影响其他资源的正常运 ⾏ ，导致不必要的权限问题。

question: To meet regulatory requirements, a security engineer needs to implement an IAM policy that restricts the use of AWS services to the us-east-1 Region. What policy should the engineer implement?

explanations.A: This policy uses Allow + StringEquals aws:RequestedRegion, which only allows requests to us-east-1 but does not explicitly deny requests to other regions. Without an explicit deny, other policies that grant permissions can still allow users to operate in other regions.
explanations.B: This policy uses ec2:Region as the condition key, which is not a valid IAM global condition key. The correct global condition key is aws:RequestedRegion for restricting region access across all AWS services.
explanations.C: Correct. This policy uses Deny + StringNotEquals aws:RequestedRegion: us-east-1, meaning all actions are denied when the requested region is not us-east-1. This is the standard approach to restrict region usage. Explicit Deny always overrides any Allow, ensuring operations outside us-east-1 are blocked regardless of other policies.
explanations.D: This policy uses NotAction with Deny, but NotAction: "*" means no actions are excluded from denial, which logically means nothing is denied. Additionally, the condition uses StringEquals instead of StringNotEquals, which reverses the logic — it would deny requests TO us-east-1 rather than to other regions.

question: A security engineer logs in to the AWS Lambda console with administrator permissions. The security engineer is trying to view logs in Amazon CloudWatch for a Lambda function that is named myFunction. When the security engineer chooses the option in the Lambda console to view logs in CloudWatch, an "error loading Log Streams" message appears. The IAM policy for the Lambda function's execution role contains the following: How should the security engineer correct the error?

options.A: Move the logs:CreateLogGroup action to the second Allow statement.
options.B: Add the logs:PutDestination action to the second Allow statement.
options.C: Add the logs:GetLogEvents action to the second Allow statement.
options.D: Add the logs:CreateLogStream action to the second Allow statement.

explanations.A: 函数如何与 CloudWatch ⽇ 志集成，以及所需的权限。 选项分析 A. Move the logs:CreateLogGroup action to the second Allow statement. 错误： logs:CreateLogGroup 的作 ⽤ 是创建 ⽇ 志组，但问题并不是 ⽇ 志组 ⽆ 法创建， ⽽ 是 ⽇ 志流 （ Log Stream ） ⽆ 法加 载。 将 logs:CreateLogGroup 移动到第 ⼆ 个语句不会解决问题，因为问题的根本原因是缺少 logs:CreateLogStream 权限。
explanations.B: Add the logs:PutDestination action to the second Allow statement. 错误： logs:PutDestination 的作 ⽤ 是管理 ⽇ 志 ⽬ 标（ Log Destination ） ，通常 ⽤ 于跨账户 ⽇ 志传输， ⽽ 不是创建或管理 ⽇ 志流。 此操作与当前问题 ⽆ 关， ⽆ 法解决 “error loading Log Streams” 问题。
explanations.C: Add the logs:GetLogEvents action to the second Allow statement. 错误： logs:GetLogEvents 的作 ⽤ 是读取 ⽇ 志事件，但问题并不是读取 ⽇ 志事件， ⽽ 是 ⽇ 志流 ⽆ 法加 载。 此操作与当前问题 ⽆ 关， ⽆ 法解决 “error loading Log Streams” 问题。
explanations.D: Allow statement. 错误： logs:CreateLogGroup 的作 ⽤ 是创建 ⽇ 志组，但问题并不是 ⽇ 志组 ⽆ 法创建， ⽽ 是 ⽇ 志流 （ Log Stream ） ⽆ 法加 载。 将 logs:CreateLogGroup 移动到第 ⼆ 个语句不会解决问题，因为问题的根本原因是缺少 logs:CreateLogStream 权限。 B. Add the logs:PutDestination action to the second Allow statement. 错误： logs:PutDestination 的作 ⽤ 是管理 ⽇ 志 ⽬ 标（ Log Destination ） ，通常 ⽤ 于跨账户 ⽇ 志传输， ⽽ 不是创建或管理 ⽇ 志流。 此操作与当前问题 ⽆ 关， ⽆ 法解决 “error loading Log Streams” 问题。 C. Add the logs:GetLogEvents action to the second Allow statement. 错误： logs:GetLogEvents 的作 ⽤ 是读取 ⽇ 志事件，但问题并不是读取 ⽇ 志事件， ⽽ 是 ⽇ 志流 ⽆ 法加 载。 此操作与当前问题 ⽆ 关， ⽆ 法解决 “error loading Log Streams” 问题。 D. Add the logs:CreateLogStream action to the second Allow statement. 正确： logs:CreateLogStream 的作 ⽤ 是创建 ⽇ 志流（ Log Stream ） ，这是 Lambda 函数在写 ⼊ ⽇ 志 到 CloudWatch 时所需的权限。 当前 IAM 策略缺少 logs:CreateLogStream 权限，导致 ⽇ 志流 ⽆ 法加载，添加此权限可以解决问题。

question: A company has a new partnership with a vendor. The vendor will process data from the company's customers. The company will upload data files as objects into an Amazon S3 bucket. The vendor will download the objects to perform data processing. The objects will contain sensitive data. A security engineer must implement a solution that prevents objects from residing in the S3 bucket for longer than 72 hours. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon Macie to scan the S3 bucket for sensitive data every 72 hours. Configure Macie to delete the objects that contain sensitive data when they are discovered.
options.B: Configure an S3 Lifecycle rule on the S3 Bucket to expire objects that have been in the S3 bucket for 72 hours.
options.C: Create an Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule that invokes an AWS Lambda function every day. Program the Lambda function to remove any objects that have been in the S3 bucket for 72 hours.
options.D: Use the S3 Intelligent-Tiering storage class for all objects that are uploaded to the S3 bucket. Use S3 Intelligent-Tiering to expire objects that have been in the $3 bucket for 72 hours.

explanations.A: 使 ⽤ Amazon Macie 每 72 ⼩ 时扫描 ⼀ 次 S3 bucket 中的敏感数据。配置 Macie 在发现包含敏感 数据的对象时删 除这些对象。 错误： Amazon Macie 是 ⼀ 种数据分类和安全性服务， ⽤ 于识别敏感数据，但它并不具备 ⾃ 动删除对 象的功能。 此外，题 ⽬ 要求的是删除所有对象， ⽽ 不是仅删除敏感数据。

question: A security engineer needs to configure an Amazon S3 bucket policy to restrict access to an S3 bucket named DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET. Which bucket policy statement meets these requirements?

explanations.B: Correct. Deny + StringNotEquals aws:sourceVpce: vpce-1a2b3c4d means: deny all s3:* actions when the source VPC Endpoint is not vpce-1a2b3c4d. Explicit Deny always overrides Allow, ensuring only requests through the specified VPCE can access the bucket.

question: A company plans to use AWS Key Management Service AWS KMS) to implement an encryption strategy to protect data at rest. The company requires client-side encryption for company projects. The company is currently conducting multiple projects to test the company's use of AWS KMS. These tests have led to a sudden increase in the company's AWS resource consumption. The test projects include applications that issue multiple requests each second to KMS endpoints for encryption activities. The company needs to develop a solution that does not throttle the company's ability to use AWS KMS. The solution must improve key usage for client-side encryption and must be cost optimized. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use keyrings with the AWS Encryption SDK. Use each keyring individually or combine keyrings into a multi-keyring. Decrypt the data by using a keyring that has the primary key in the multi- keyring.
options.B: Use data key caching. Use the local cache that the AWS Encryption SDK provides with a caching cryptographic materials manager.
options.C: Use KMS key rotation. Use a local cache in the AWS Encryption SDK with a caching cryptographic materials manager.
options.D: Use keyrings with the AWS Encryption SDK. Use each keyring individually or combine keyrings into a multi-keyring. Use any of the wrapping keys in the multi-keyring to decrypt the data.

explanations.A: 使 ⽤ keyrings 与 multi-keyring 解密数据： 此选项提到使 ⽤ keyrings 和 multi-keyring ，但没有解决 ⾼ 频请求导致的资源消耗问题。虽然 keyrings 是 AWS Encryption SDK 的功能之 ⼀ ，但它主要 ⽤ 于管理多个密钥， ⽽ 不是优化请求频率。因此此选项不符合题 ⽬ 要求。
explanations.B: 使 ⽤ 数据密钥缓存： 此选项提到使 ⽤ AWS Encryption SDK 提供的本地缓存与缓存加密材料管理器。数据密钥缓存可以减 少对 KMS 的频繁请求，因为加密操作可以使 ⽤ 缓存的密钥， ⽽ 不是每次都请求新的密钥。这直接解 决了资源消耗和请求限制问题，同时 也是成本优化的有效 ⽅ 法。因此此选项是正确答案。
explanations.C: 使 ⽤ KMS 密钥轮换与本地缓存： 密钥轮换是 ⼀ 个安全最佳实践，但它与解决 ⾼ 频请求问题 ⽆ 关。虽然提到使 ⽤ 本地缓存，但密钥轮换 的重点是定期更换密钥以提 ⾼ 安全性， ⽽ 不是优化请求频率。因此此选项不完全符合题 ⽬ 要求。
explanations.D: 使 ⽤ keyrings 与 multi-keyring 解密数据： 此选项与选项 A 类似，提到使 ⽤ keyrings 和 multi-keyring ，但没有解决 ⾼ 频请求导致的资源消耗问 题。虽然 keyrings 是 AWS Encryption SDK 的功能之 ⼀ ，但它主要 ⽤ 于管理多个密钥， ⽽ 不是优化请求频率。因此此选项 不符合题 ⽬ 要求。

question: A security team is working on a solution that will use Amazon EventBridge to monitor new Amazon S3 objects. While developing the solution in a single account, the security team discovers that the s3 PutObjectAcl API call does not invoke an EventBridge event However, the s3 DeleteBucketPolicy API call and the s3 PutBucketPolicy API call do invoke an event. The security team has enabled CloudTrail for AWS management events with a basic configuration in the AWS Region in which EventBridge is being tested. Verification of the EventBridge event pattern indicates that the pattern is set up correctly. options.A: Modify the EventBridge event pattern by selecting Amazon S3. Select All Events as the event type.
options.B: Modify the EventBridge event pattern by selecting Amazon S3. Select Bucket Level Operations as the event type.
options.C: Enable CloudTrail Insights to identify unusual API activity.
options.D: Enable CloudTrail to monitor data events for read and write operations to S3 buckets. Most Voted.

explanations.A: 修改 EventBridge 事件模式，选择 Amazon S3 ，将事件类型设置为 All Events 。 错误：虽然选择 “ 所有事件 ” 可能会捕获更多事件，但它会导致 ⽣ 成 ⼤ 量不相关的事件，可能会产 ⽣ 误 报。 此外，问题明确要求避免 ⽣ 成错误通知，因此此选项不符合要求。
explanations.B: 修改 EventBridge 事件模式，选择 Amazon S3 ，将事件类型设置为 Bucket Level Operations 。 错误： Bucket Level Operations 仅监控与桶级别相关的操作，例如创建、删除或修改桶， ⽽ 不会捕获 对象级别的操作 （如 s3 PutObjectAcl ） 。 此选项 ⽆ 法解决问题中提到的 s3 PutObjectAcl 事件未触发的问题。
explanations.C: 启 ⽤ CloudTrail Insights 以识别异常的 API 活动。 错误： CloudTrail Insights ⽤ 于检测异常的 API 活动，例如突然的流量激增或模式变化，但它不会直接 解决问题中提到的 s3 PutObjectAcl 事件未触发的问题。 此选项与问题要求 ⽆ 关。
explanations.D: Use the GuardDuty CreateFilter API operation... 分析：此选项试图结合 CreateFilter API 和 EventBridge 规则，但 CreateFilter API 的使 ⽤ 在此场景中并 ⾮ 必要。直接使 ⽤ EventBridge 规则匹配 GuardDuty 事件更简单有效。 结论：错误。

question: 英 ⽂ A company's AWS CloudTrail logs are al centraly stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. The security team controls the company's AWS account. The security team must prevent unauthorized access and tampering of the CloudTrail logs. Which combination of steps should the security team take? Choose three.)

options.A: Configure server-side encryption with AWS KMS managed encryption keys SSE KMS .
options.B: Compress log files with secure gzip.
options.C: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to notify the security team of any modifications on CloudTrail log files.
options.D: Implement least privilege access to the S3 bucket by configuring a bucket policy.
options.E: Configure CloudTrail log file integrity validation.

explanations.A: server-side encryption with AWS KMS managed encryption keys SSE KMS . 分 析：正确。使 ⽤ SSE KMS 可以确 保 ⽇ 志 ⽂ 件在存储时被加密，从 ⽽ 防 ⽌ 未经授权的访问。这是保护数据的 ⼀ 项重要措施。
explanations.B: Compress log files with secure gzip. 分析：错误。虽然压缩 ⽇ 志 ⽂ 件可以节省存储空间，但它 与防 ⽌ 未经授权的访问 和篡改 ⽆ 关，也不是 CloudTrail ⽇ 志安全性的核 ⼼ 要求。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to notify the security team of any modifications on CloudTrail log files. 分析：错误。 虽然通知机制可以帮助监控 ⽇ 志 ⽂ 件的修改，但它 ⽆ 法直接防 ⽌ 未经授权的访问或篡改。此选项不是 最佳实践的 ⼀ 部 分。
explanations.D: Implement least privilege access to the S3 bucket by configuring a bucket policy. 分析：正 确。通过配置存储桶策略并实 施最 ⼩ 权限原则，可以限制对 ⽇ 志 ⽂ 件的访问，从 ⽽ 防 ⽌ 未经授权的访问。
explanations.E: Configure CloudTrail log file integrity validation. 分析：正确。 CloudTrail ⽇ 志 ⽂ 件完整性验证 可以检测 ⽇ 志 ⽂ 件是否被 篡改，是确保 ⽇ 志 ⽂ 件安全性的重要步骤。
explanations.F: Configure Access Analyzer for S3. 分析：错误。 Access Analyzer for S3 主要 ⽤ 于分析存储桶 的访问权限，但它 ⽆ 法直 接防 ⽌ ⽇ 志 ⽂ 件的篡改或未经授权的访问。

question: A company's policy requires that all API keys be encrypted and stored separately from source code in a centralized security account. Create a presigned URL for the S3 key, and specify the URL in a Lambda environmental variable in the AWS CloudFormation template. Update the Lambda function code to retrieve the key using the URL and call the API.
options.C: Create a secret in AWS Secrets Manager in the security account to store the API key using AWS Key Management Service AWS KMS) for encryption. Grant access to the IAM role used by the Lambda function so that the function can retrieve the key from Secrets Manager and call the API.
options.D: Create an encrypted environment variable for the Lambda function to store the API key using AWS Key Management Service AWS KMS) for encryption. Grant access to the IAM role used by the Lambda function so that the function can decrypt the key at runtime.

question: A company uses SAML federation to grant users access to AWS accounts. question: A security engineer is troubleshooting an AWS Lambda function that is named MyLambdaFunction. The function is encountering an error when the function attempts to read the objects in an Amazon S3 bucket that is named DOC EXAMPLEBUCKET. The S3 bucket has the following bucket policy: Which change should the security engineer make to the policy to ensure that the Lambda function can read the bucket objects?

options.A: Remove the Condition element. Change the Principal element to the following:
options.B: Change the Action element to the following:
options.C: Change the Resource element to "arn:aws:s3 DOC EXAMPLE BUCKET/ ''. 将 Resource 元素更改为 "arn:aws:s3 DOC EXAMPLE BUCKET/ " 。
options.D: Change the Resource element to "arn:aws:lambda:::function:MyLambdaFunction". Change the Principal element to the following:

explanations.A: 函数能够访问 S3 资 源。 涉及的知识点包括： Principal 、 Action 、 Resource 、 Condition 元素的使 ⽤ ，以及 S3 ARN 格式的正 确性。 选项分析 A. Remove the Condition element. Change the Principal element to the following: 移除 Condition 元素会导致策略失去对特定 Lambda 函数的限制，变得过于宽松，可能允许其他 Lambda 函数访问该 S3 Bucket 。 更改 Principal 元素可能会破坏当前策略的正确性，因为当前 Principal 已经正确指定了 Lambda 服务。 此选项不解决问题，且可能引 ⼊ 安全 ⻛ 险，因此错误。
explanations.B: Change the Action element to the following: Action 元素当前已经正确设置为 "s3 GetObject" ，这是 Lambda 函数读取 S3 对象所需的权限。 更改 Action 元素没有意义，因为问题不在于 Action 的配置，因此此选项错误。
explanations.C: Change the Resource element to "arn:aws:s3 DOC EXAMPLE BUCKET/*". 当前 Resource 元素仅指定了 Bucket 本 ⾝ ， ⽽ 未包含 Bucket 中的对象（即未包含 / 后缀） 。 Lambda 函数需要访问 Bucket 中的对象，因此 Resource 需要指定为 "arn:aws:s3 DOC EXAMPLE BUCKET/ " 。 此选项正确，因为它解决了问题并符合最佳实践。
explanations.D: Change the Resource element to "arn:aws:lambda:::function:MyLambdaFunction". Change the Principal element to the following: 将 Resource 更改为 Lambda 函数的 ARN 是错误的，因为 Resource 应该指定 S3 Bucket 及其对象， ⽽ 不是 Lambda 函数。 更改 Principal 元素也没有意义，因为当前 Principal 已经正确指定了 Lambda 服务。 此选项完全错误。

question: An IAM user receives an Access Denied message when the user attempts to access objects in an Amazon S3 bucket. The user and the S3 bucket are in the same AWS account. The S3 bucket is configured to use server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys SSE KMS) to encrypt all of its objects at rest by using a customer managed key from the same AWS account. The S3 bucket has no bucket policy defined. The IAM user has been granted permissions through an IAM policy that allows the kms:Decrypt permission to the customer managed key. The IAM policy also allows the s3 List* and s3 Get* permissions for the S3 bucket and its objects. Which of the following is a possible reason that the IAM user cannot access the objects in the S3 bucket?

options.A: The IAM policy needs to allow the kms:DescribeKey permission.
options.B: The S3 bucket has been changed to use the AWS managed key to encrypt objects at rest.
options.C: An S3 bucket policy needs to be added to allow the IAM user to access the objects.
options.D: The KMS key policy has been edited to remove the ability for the AWS account to have full access to the key.

explanations.A: The IAM policy needs to allow the kms:DescribeKey permission. 错误： kms:DescribeKey 权限 ⽤ 于查看密钥的元数据，但与解密操作 ⽆ 关。 ⽤ 户已经拥有 kms:Decrypt 权限，这 ⾜ 以解密 对象。
explanations.B: The S3 bucket has been changed to use the AWS managed key to encrypt objects at rest. 错误：题 ⽬ 明确说明 S3 存储桶使 ⽤ 的是客户管理密钥（ Customer Managed Key ） ， ⽽ 不是 AWS 管理 密钥（ AWS Managed Key ） 。此选项与题 ⽬ 描述不符。
explanations.C: An S3 bucket policy needs to be added to allow the IAM user to access the objects. 错误：题 ⽬ 明确说明 S3 存储桶没有定义存储桶策略，但 IAM ⽤ 户已经通过 IAM 策略获得了 s3 List 和 s3 Get 权限，因此不 需要额外的存储桶策略。
explanations.D: to use the AWS managed key to encrypt objects at rest. 错误：题 ⽬ 明确说明 S3 存储桶使 ⽤ 的是客户管理密钥（ Customer Managed Key ） ， ⽽ 不是 AWS 管理 密钥（ AWS Managed Key ） 。此选项与题 ⽬ 描述不符。 C. An S3 bucket policy needs to be added to allow the IAM user to access the objects. 错误：题 ⽬ 明确说明 S3 存储桶没有定义存储桶策略，但 IAM ⽤ 户已经通过 IAM 策略获得了 s3 List 和 s3 Get 权限，因此不 需要额外的存储桶策略。 D. The KMS key policy has been edited to remove the ability for the AWS account to have full access to the key. 正确： KMS 密钥策略是控制密钥访问的核 ⼼ 机制。如果密钥策略被编辑并移除了 AWS 账户对密钥的完 全访问权限，即使 IAM 策略允许 kms:Decrypt 权限， ⽤ 户仍然 ⽆ 法解密对象。

question: A company has a guideline that mandates the encryption of all Amazon S3 bucket data in transit. A security engineer must implement an S3 bucket policy that denies any S3 operations if data is not encrypted. Which S3 bucket policy will meet this requirement?

explanations.A: This policy uses Deny + Bool aws:SecureTransport: true, meaning it denies requests when HTTPS IS used. This is the opposite of the requirement — it would deny encrypted transport and allow unencrypted transport.
explanations.B: Correct. Deny + Bool aws:SecureTransport: false means: deny all s3:* actions when HTTPS is NOT used (SecureTransport is false). This ensures only HTTPS encrypted transport can access the bucket, meeting the in-transit encryption requirement.
explanations.C: This policy uses StringNotEquals s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption: AES256, which checks server-side encryption (encryption at rest), not in-transit encryption. The requirement is for encryption in transit (HTTPS), which requires the aws:SecureTransport condition key.
explanations.D: Similar to option C, this checks server-side encryption rather than transport encryption. Additionally, the condition value uses boolean true instead of a string — s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption expects string values like "AES256" or "aws:kms", making the syntax incorrect.

question: A security engineer needs to implement a write-once-read-many WORM) model for data that a company will store in Amazon S3 buckets.
